correctness.rationale: For G=K6−01+06+16 and G+=G+01, faces of NM3 are exactly edge masks containing no one of the 42 and 45 forbidden three-edge matchings, respectively. Independently enumerated all allowed subsets in chain dimensions 3–6 and performed exact F2 boundary elimination: G size4..7 face counts (1361,2188,2103,1162), ranks ∂4=948, ∂5=1236, ∂6=862; G+ counts (1843,3366,3805,2580), ranks (1328,2038,1758). Therefore Htilde4 dimensions 2188−948−1236=4, 3366−1328−2038=0. The inclusion map on H4 is zero with 4-dimensional kernel; H5 dimensions 5,9 are contextual. This is a finite exhaustive certificate, not a partial graph census.
